Jewel City Hijackings

By: Graham Coetzer | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Scores of seemingly unrelated murders and hijackings in the JHB cbd are actually all connected - the one link? The Johannesburg Gold and Diamond Centre

Summary:
The Johannesburg Gold and Diamond Center, also known as Jewel City is home to more than 300 gold and diamond traders. A plague of violent hijackings, all seemingly unrelated, and dating back as far as 2012, are actually all connected to Jewel City. The reason? Gold and diamond dealers, both legit and illegitimate, are selling raw materials at Jewel City and being paid cash. Insiders at Jewel City's security, and also spotters placed around the buildings, are then supplying the hijacking syndicate with info about who is leaving, when and with how much cash. The Hijackers then use the same M.O. in every incident. The victim's vehicle is surrounded by 2 or 3 hijackers vehicles, armed men jump out, almost always fire first without asking any questions, know what to look for and take in the victim's vehicle and then make off with the cash in a operation carried out with military precision. The Hawks are aware that these incidents are connected, but to date, nothing has been done to stop the scourge.

Further information:
We have an insider in a very high position in SAPS who has confirmed they are aware of the problem - and who has also provided us with documentary proof that Senior SAPS officials have been made aware of the issue. He has also confirmed that SAPS believes that staff of the security companies employed by Jewel City are involved and also that some SAPS members are assisting the syndicates. Most of our case studies are involved in the illegal gold trade but are willing to give us interviews as long as their identities are protected. They were all followed from Jewel City and hijacked within a five block radius. WE have been given CCTV footage of two hijackings and one attempted hijacking. We also have dash-cam footage of another hijacking to use. We have been supplied with a list of 30 case numbers from our SAPS insider that the police have connected to the same syndicate - but a security insider has supplied us with his list which is over 50 incidents. All of them have the same M.O., including cases of murder, attempted murder and theft. We have a refinery inside Jewel City who are willing to go on the record in an on camera interview. Our SAPS source MIGHT give an interview if his identity is protected.

Case Study:
Hidden ID Venus
Tobie Snyman Former Gold Trader
Hidden ID Juno Gold Trader
HIDDEN ID Pluto Gold Trader
Barend Nortje General Manager

Expert:
Mr. HIDDEN ID Jupiter SAPS INSIDER

Locations:
Johannesburg

Other Footage Sources:
CCTV from various sources

Hidden Camera: Yes
Reason for hidden camera: We want to enter Jewel City with a hidden camera to show the entry and exit procedure of the security company, as all our sources believe this is where the info leaks from.

Legal: Yes
Reason for legal: Allegations against security and SAPS

Press Release:


Jewel City Hijackings
Scores of apparently unrelated murders and hijackings in the Johannesburg CBD are actually all connected. The common link? The Johannesburg Gold and Diamond Centre, also known as Jewel City. It’s home to more than 300 gold and diamond dealers who sell raw materials for cash. With military precision, armed robbers repeatedly target victims leaving the centre, surrounding their vehicles and shooting at will before making off with the victim’s cash. Law enforcement officials have seemingly connected the dots, but nothing has been done to stop the scourge. Carte Blanche investigates.


Script:


Jewel City Hijackings
26 Nov 2015

Voice
November 2013 and yet another violent hijacking takes place in the Johannesburg CBD. CCTV cameras on Commissioner street capture the scene as armed gunmen force the passengers out of the vehicle before making off with their spoils. Literally a few days later, on the very same spot and the hijackers are at it again, this time making off with a large amount of cash and a small bakkie.

Link Devi
Violent robberies no longer make headlines in South Africa and the same can be said for violent attacks in Johannesburg’s CBD. But in the past three years there have been 30 cases all with one thing in common – Jewel City.

Voice
Jewel City, spans 4 city blocks in the CDB, bounded by Commissioner and Main streets in the north and south, and Berea and Phillip streets in the east and west. Known in the trade as the Gold and Diamond Center, it houses over three hundred gold and diamond dealers. About R7 billion changes hands in the precinct every year and it’s the hub of Gauteng’s gold and diamond trade. But the lure of gold, diamonds and cash has also attracted the attention of organized crime…

Sound Up Tobie Snyman
Devi: So you buy second hand jewellery and then what would do you do with the second hand jewellery?

Tobie: At that stage I would take it into the diamond center or the jewellery center that’s in town in the Johannesburg CBD, and then sell it to them and then they would pay me for it on the spot.

Voice
Tobie Snyman used to run successful business selling second hand jewellery for its value in the raw materials such as gold. Like many of the traders who sell their goods at Jewel City, he would usually be paid in cash.

Sound Up Tobie
Devi: So you could be carrying cash in large amounts, small amounts?

Tobie: It will vary because they charge you a refining fee. So I tried to rake up a bit of gold before I go there.

Voice
Tobie would often leave Jewel City with anything between R20 000 and a couple of hundred thousand rand in cash. On the 9th of August 2013 though, Tobie’s life would be changed forever. After making a sale at Jewel City, Tobie’s car was followed and forced off the road by three armed gunmen.

Sound Up Tobie
Tobie: Within the next two seconds a shot goes off…

Devi: They shot where?

Tobie: Through the window, the guy on the left shot into my car. So…

Voice
The bullet tore through both of Tobie’s legs. In shock and pain Tobie opened his car door and got out of the vehicle.

Sound Up Tobie
Tobie: So now they are behind me. And to be honest with you the only thing that’s spinning through my head a million times is the next thing you hear will be the last thing you hear. You know?

Voice
Tobie collapsed at the rear of his car. The men never spoke a single word to him and they weren’t after his car either. They went straight to his boot where he had put a bag containing R13 500 in cash – the proceeds of his morning’s sale at Jewel City.

Sound Up Tobie
I said: “Oh, this is now what it’s about.” They wanted the money, which they were hoping might have been much more than which they took.

Voice
Carte Blanche has been able to verify 31 separate armed robberies, starting in 2013 2013, that all have the same common thread – traders leaving Jewel City, followed and then attacked for either their cash or gold and diamonds.. One of the latest incidents occurred in November last year when a driver from a private courier company was shot in the head and robbed of an undisclosed amount of cash and jewellery.

Link Devi
Police say that victims often don’t want to report the attacks because then they are going to have to explain why they are carrying such large amounts of cash.

Sound Up Tobie
You will find out of a hundred people maybe five people doing it ethically – customers right. Then the people you sell to, they’ve got ways of bending things. So it’s a very unethical business.

Voice
Both the gold and diamond trades in South Africa are infested with syndicates prospering from the illicit trade in these materials. And according to our insiders not all the trades happening at Jewel City are above board.

Sound Up Venus
People will come and bring diamonds or gold and … if I’m bringing illegal stuff in there, it automatically becomes legal, because once I give it to you as a licensee, it’s half legal, I just must put it through my books. But I obtained it illegally.

Voice
This man, who we’ll call Venus, is a police insider who investigates crimes such as the black market trade in gold and diamonds. To protect his identity, we have re-filmed his interview using an actor. Venus believes the violence is linked to organized crime, and that up to three different syndicates might be behind the attacks.

Sound Up Venus
it is a real problem because like the followings emanates from the diamond centre… where the diamond centre is the hub of Gauteng’s gold and diamond industry because most of the businesses there deals with gold and diamonds. It’s an organized crime group.


Voice
SARS spokesperson Sandile Memela says the black market trade in gold costs the South African taxpayer billions.

Sound Up Sandile
At the moment we have 26 cases that are under investigation, these pertain to companies and individuals that deal in illicit gold trading. Government has looked into this matter and our conservative estimates, especially based on the 26 cases that SARS is looking into, that the money that we lose amounts to R5.6 billion. That’s a lot of money in any language.

Voice
The 26 SARS cases are unrelated to Jewel City, but it’s a bitter reminder of the scale of the black market gold trade. Venus says both legal and illegal traders are falling victim to the attacks linked to Jewel City.

Sound Up Venus
It’s an organized crime group. A syndicate. And I would not limit it to one syndicate.

Voice
This CCTV footage, filmed in Commissioner street just a few blocks from Jewel City, shows a trader who had just left the precinct with about R50 000 in cash in his boot, trying to evade a group of armed robbers. Unfortunately a short way down the street the syndicate was able to force him off the road – making their escape with the cash after a shootout.

Link Devi
Our police insider believes these are not random cases – the M.O. is the same. Traders are followed from Jewel City and are attacked by armed gunmen who know exactly what they want and where to find it.

Sound Up Venus
Ak47s, police issued firearms, fast vehicles and inside knowledge. When they want the stuff they will know exactly what you have and where it’s supposed to be.

Sound Up Jarrod
Devi: Why would you opt to have cash when you can just rather opt to get the money in your bank account?

Jarrod: When we buy, we buy with cash. So every time you need to go to the bank you pay bank fees and withdrawal charges and everything. So it’s easier to take cash from the center then you’ve got cash to buy again.

Voice
This man, who we’ll call Jarrod, has asked us to hide his identity due to fear of reprisals. Like Tobie, he also sells gold to refineries within Jewel City. And like Tobie, he also fell victim to a syndicate.

Sound Up Jarrod
I got into my bakkie and I drove out of the center like I normally do. Got onto the M2 through to City Deep. At City Deep I parked behind a meat truck and I saw movement and I looked to my right and I saw the guy standing about two meters away from me with a pistol aimed at me.

Voice
Jarrod put pedal to the metal in an attempt to escape his attackers.

Sound Up Jarrod
…Went through the taxi and the meat truck, and they started shooting at me and I got through, I got out, and about 3km away from that my bakkie stopped and when my bakkie stopped they pulled in front of me and they came for the second time.

Voice
Jarrod had his pistol on him and returned fire on the three armed assailants from within his vehicle – scaring them off.

Sound Up Jarrod
Jarrod: After the cops were there and everything they told me there was a guy on my left hand side as well. And he actually shot out my rear tire, that’s why the bakkie stopped. They wanted me to stop again.

Devi: So this wasn’t a hijacking?

Jarrod: No, it was attempted murder, they came to kill I’m sure.

Voice
Our case studies believe the syndicates are getting information on their victims from inside Jewel City.

Sound Up Tobie
They hand-picked what they wanted. So it’s someone that is informed, was informed, you know, directed…

Sound Up Jarrod
Jarrod: No we’re definitely targeted, we get watched there by the people.

Devi: How many people have been targeted?

Jarrod: Lots. Very, there’s a lot of people that have been targeted. And they’re still being targeted.

Voice
A lot of the attacks go hand in hand with extreme violence, with at least three of the incidents involving murders.

Sound Up Venus
…They are robbing these people on the street, stray bullets are going to hit who? They are going to kill who for a thing that is not affecting them. So it’s affecting everybody, because it is not happening in a secluded area, it is happening in public.


Sound Up Jarrod
Devi: …In your case, I mean it was a shootout?

Jarrod: Ja

Devi: Traffic, people walking around?

Jarrod: Ja there was a lot of cars going past us and that.

Link Devi
Our investigation shows that these cases are treated in isolation. The police don’t seem to be linking the different cases and as a result the syndicates are getting away with it.

Voice
These police documents, leaked to Carte Blanche, show 30 cases where police believe the victims were followed from Jewel City. The problem is the cases are made at different police stations, depending on where an incident took place, and also under different charges and different case numbers.

Sound Up Venus
The cases are investigated independently…The police departments are not talking to each other and then closing down the cases as there is no information, there’s nothing to link or to apprehend the criminals.

Voice
Our case studies reported the incidents to the police, but they say no arrests have ever been made.

Sound Up Jarrod
Because none of the guys got caught, and a lot of guys that we spoke to their dockets went missing – nothing ever happened afterward. They never phoned me back to say this or that or anything.

Sound Up Tobie
Devi: And the police?
Tobie: (laughs)

Voice
We approached both the Hawks and the South African Police Service for comment on this story but they declined to give us interviews. In a written response from the police they said: “The team responsible as per your request advised that the investigation is at a sensitive stage and therefore we are unable to conduct an interview…”.

Sound Up Venus
So the different police departments act as silos no one’s talking to each other, incompetence and corruption. The lack of experience, the lack of knowledge, and yes police corruption as well because there are police involved.

Voice
Tobie has since left the business on moral grounds and is now studying theology. He says small changes in security procedures at Jewel City could make a big difference.

Sound Up Tobie
Devi: Why do you think the diamond and gold center, they never sent some kind of correspondence to people who deal there to say take care.

Tobie:
If they change the system that nobody has cellphones, it will make a big difference already.

Voice
We approached Redefine Properties, the management of Jewel City, for comment on this story but they declined to be interviewed. In their written response to us they said that people leaving Jewel City need to “ensure that they take adequate precautions once they leave the precinct as all incidents referred to have occurred outside the precinct.” Ultimately though, it will be up to the police to take down the syndicates.

Sound Up Venus
the police department must talk to each other, put the differences aside, and work together, because these people can be caught. It is not difficult and we do not need rocket science, just normal things to catch them.

Jarrod: Ja Devi: Traffic, people walking around? Jarrod: Ja there was a lot of cars going past us and that. Link Devi Our investigation shows that these cases are treated in isolation. The police don’t seem to be linking the different cases and as a result the syndicates are getting away with it. Voice These police documents, leaked to Carte Blanche, show 30 cases where police believe the victims were followed from Jewel City. The problem is the cases are made at different police stations, depending on where an incident took place, and also under different charges and different case numbers. Sound Up Venus The cases are investigated independently…The police departments are not talking to each other and then closing down the cases as there is no information, there’s nothing to link or to apprehend the criminals. Voice Our case studies reported the incidents to the police, but they say no arrests have ever been made. Sound Up Jarrod Because none of the guys got caught, and a lot of guys that we spoke to their dockets went missing – nothing ever happened afterward. They never phoned me back to say this or that or anything. Sound Up Tobie Devi: And the police? Tobie: (laughs) Voice We approached both the Hawks and the South African Police Service for comment on this story but they declined to give us interviews. In a written response from the police they said: “The team responsible as per your request advised that the investigation is at a sensitive stage and therefore we are unable to conduct an interview…”. Sound Up Venus So the different police departments act as silos no one’s talking to each other, incompetence and corruption. The lack of experience, the lack of knowledge, and yes police corruption as well because there are police involved. Voice Tobie has since left the business on moral grounds and is now studying theology. He says small changes in security procedures at Jewel City could make a big difference. Sound Up Tobie Devi: Why do you think the diamond and gold center, they never sent some kind of correspondence to people who deal there to say take care. Tobie: If they change the system that nobody has cellphones, it will make a big difference already. Voice We approached Redefine Properties, the management of Jewel City, for comment on this story but they declined to be interviewed. In their written response to us they said that people leaving Jewel City need to “ensure that they take adequate precautions once they leave the precinct as all incidents referred to have occurred outside the precinct.” Ultimately though, it will be up to the police to take down the syndicates. Sound Up Venus the police department must talk to each other, put the differences aside, and work together, because these people can be caught. It is not difficult and we do not need rocket science, just normal things to catch them.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Scores of seemingly unrelated murders and hijackings in the JHB cbd are actually all connected - the one link? The Johannesburg Gold and Diamond Centre
metadata.Summary: The Johannesburg Gold and Diamond Center, also known as Jewel City is home to more than 300 gold and diamond traders. A plague of violent hijackings, all seemingly unrelated, and dating back as far as 2012, are actually all connected to Jewel City. The reason? Gold and diamond dealers, both legit and illegitimate, are selling raw materials at Jewel City and being paid cash. Insiders at Jewel City's security, and also spotters placed around the buildings, are then supplying the hijacking syndicate with info about who is leaving, when and with how much cash. The Hijackers then use the same M.O. in every incident. The victim's vehicle is surrounded by 2 or 3 hijackers vehicles, armed men jump out, almost always fire first without asking any questions, know what to look for and take in the victim's vehicle and then make off with the cash in a operation carried out with military precision. The Hawks are aware that these incidents are connected, but to date, nothing has been done to stop the scourge.
metadata.Further information: We have an insider in a very high position in SAPS who has confirmed they are aware of the problem - and who has also provided us with documentary proof that Senior SAPS officials have been made aware of the issue. He has also confirmed that SAPS believes that staff of the security companies employed by Jewel City are involved and also that some SAPS members are assisting the syndicates. Most of our case studies are involved in the illegal gold trade but are willing to give us interviews as long as their identities are protected. They were all followed from Jewel City and hijacked within a five block radius. WE have been given CCTV footage of two hijackings and one attempted hijacking. We also have dash-cam footage of another hijacking to use. We have been supplied with a list of 30 case numbers from our SAPS insider that the police have connected to the same syndicate - but a security insider has supplied us with his list which is over 50 incidents. All of them have the same M.O., including cases of murder, attempted murder and theft. We have a refinery inside Jewel City who are willing to go on the record in an on camera interview. Our SAPS source MIGHT give an interview if his identity is protected.
